lines.japanese: だが、奈落に吹く風は漸次その強度と頻度を増していった。
lines.english: Yet the winds of the abyss grew steadily in strength and frequency.

lines.japanese: 下賎の者にこうべを垂れるなど、私の中に脈々と流れるやんごとなき血が許すべくもないが、しかしフェニックスとその従士にだけは礼を述べねばなるまい。
lines.english: The noble blood coursing through my veins could never permit me to bow before my inferiors. Nevertheless, to Phoenix and his retainers alone I must offer thanks.

lines.japanese: 彼らは凪の冥府に波風を立てるべく、我が愚弟に小ざかしい策を弄して働きかけたのだから。
lines.english: For through their petty stratagems they worked upon my foolish brother, raising waves upon the becalmed waters of Hades.

lines.japanese: 「アリス！」
lines.english: “Alice!”

lines.japanese: 「ジムはかばった私を……そしてジムはたおれた……」
lines.english: “Jim protect me... Then Jim fall...”

lines.japanese: 「マルチネスはどうした」
lines.english: “What happened to Martinez?”

lines.japanese: 「ドラ、逃げろ。ドラ、きけん」
lines.english: “Dra, run. Dra in danger.”

lines.japanese: じわじわ迫る敵意の影に、ファルコンの血が沸きたつ。おいぼれ牧師の呪いが解けてゆく。轟々と吹きすさぶ風の中で私は嗤っていた。
lines.english: As the shadow of hostility crept closer, Falcon's blood began to boil. The old pastor's curse weakened. Amid the roaring gale, I laughed.

lines.japanese: ぷぷ、くはは、はははははァァァ！
lines.english: Pff, kuhaha, hahahahahaaaa!

lines.japanese: 「目撃者の証言によりますと、大勢の通行人で賑わう中、とつぜんパンという大きな音が聞こえ、次の瞬間、男性がひとりうずくまるように倒れたということです」
lines.english: “According to witnesses, the street was crowded with pedestrians when a sudden loud bang was heard. The next moment, they saw a man crumple to the ground.”

lines.japanese: 「調べによると男性は美空区の自由業・江藤弘之さん２３歳で、江藤さんは急ぎ美空総合病院へ運ばれましたが、出血多量などにより二時間後に死亡しました──」
lines.english: “Police have identified the man as Hiroyuki Eto, twenty-three, a self-employed resident of Misora Ward. Mr. Eto was rushed to Misora General Hospital but died two hours later from blood loss and related complications—”

lines.japanese: 「プラ……チナ……」
lines.english: “Pla... tinum...”

lines.japanese: 轟々、轟々と黒い風が俺を突きあげる。
lines.english: Roaring, roaring, the black wind drove me upward.

lines.japanese: 「赦さねえ！　赦さねえ、あのオウム頭……ブッ殺す……ブッ殺すぞクソヤロウ！」
lines.english: “I won't forgive him! I won't forgive that parrot-headed bastard... I'll kill him... I'll fucking kill him!”

lines.japanese: 湧け。怒れ。爆ぜろ。
lines.english: Seethe. Rage. Explode.

lines.japanese: 私は彼の内奥から、精神の薄皮を引っかくような声で囁きかけた。
lines.english: From deep within him, I whispered in a voice that scratched at the thin skin of his mind.

lines.japanese: 汝の敵を裁け。汝の敵を裁け。汝の敵を裁け。
lines.english: Pass judgment upon thine enemy. Pass judgment upon thine enemy. Pass judgment upon thine enemy.

lines.japanese: 「なあ、成田隼人。ファルコン。自分で気付いているか？　仲間をやられたと言うおまえの目に悲しみはない。あるのは憎悪と怨嗟の暗い埋み火だ。その怒りをもって、おまえは敵をどうしたいんだ」
lines.english: “Tell me, Hayato Narita. Falcon. Have you noticed? You say your comrade was hurt, yet there is no sorrow in your eyes. Only the dark embers of hatred and resentment, banked beneath the ash. With that anger, what do you want to do to your enemy?”

lines.japanese: 汝の敵を裁け。
lines.english: Pass judgment upon thine enemy.

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。喋ってんじゃねえよ。んなこた聞いてねえ！　言え！　やつはどこだ！」
lines.english: “Shut up. Stop talking. I didn't ask for any of that! Tell me! Where is he?”

lines.japanese: 汝の敵を裁け。
lines.english: Pass judgment upon thine enemy.

lines.japanese: 「殴りたいのか？　復讐したいのか？　制裁を加えたいのか？」
lines.english: “Do you want to strike him? Take revenge? Punish him?”

lines.japanese: 汝の敵を裁け。
lines.english: Pass judgment upon thine enemy.

lines.japanese: 「ブッ殺したいんだろ？」
lines.english: “You want to fucking kill him, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえっ！」
lines.english: “Shut up!”

lines.japanese: 「くふっ！」
lines.english: “Kuh!”

lines.japanese: ファルコンの激昂が暴力に高じてフェニックスへ放たれた瞬間、ひゃっほうい、ひときわ激しい風が私を衝きあげた。
lines.english: The instant Falcon's fury swelled into violence and flew at Phoenix—yippee!—a gust fiercer than all the rest launched me upward.

lines.japanese: 竪穴の最上部から射しこむ光を浴び、ついに私は出口の縁に手をかけた。
lines.english: Bathed in the light pouring through the mouth of the shaft, I caught its rim at last.

lines.japanese: 上出来だ。一瞬とはいえ牧師の呪いを撥ねのけた愚弟に、私は賛辞を送った。
lines.english: Splendid. I offered my foolish brother due praise for throwing off the pastor's curse, if only for an instant.

lines.japanese: が、それが貴様の限界だ。去ね。去んで玉座を余に空けよ、ファルコン。
lines.english: But that is the limit of your power. Begone. Leave the throne to me, Falcon.

lines.japanese: 「うるせえええっ！」
lines.english: “Shut uuuuup!”

lines.japanese: 彼は頭を掻きむしって叫ぶ。だが私の半分はすでに竪穴の外。王の声は確実に彼の内側まで届いていた。
lines.english: He screamed, clawing at his hair. Yet half of me had already emerged from the shaft. The voice of his king had reached him, deep inside.

lines.japanese: あとひと押し、いまもうひと吹きの風さえ来たれば、私は久しく恋い焦がれた光のもとへ！　感奮である！（私はとてもぱきぱきしてきました）
lines.english: One final push—one more gust, and I should stand beneath the light for which I had yearned so long! I was electrified! (I was feeling positively wired.)

lines.japanese: 「イイんだぜぇ、もっと殴ってよぉ」
lines.english: “That's fiiine. Hit me some more.”

lines.japanese: 「黙れ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 「殴れよ」
lines.english: “Hit me.”

lines.japanese: 「黙れ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: ようし、扇げ！　我が愚弟を扇げフェニックス！
lines.english: Yes! Fan him! Fan the flames of my foolish brother, Phoenix!

lines.japanese: 「殴っとけよ、オラもっともっともっともっともっとォォォ！！」
lines.english: “Hit me, then! Come on—more, more, more, more, moooooore!”

lines.japanese: 「うる……せえええええっ！」
lines.english: “Shut... uuuuuuup!”

lines.japanese: だが、やはりファルコンの怒りは爺々の呪いを破れなかった。彼はとても臆病だから、火の点いた感情をもの言わぬ無機物に爆発させることで脇へ捌いてしまったのだ。なんと、まあ、もったいない。
lines.english: Yet Falcon's anger once again failed to break the old man's curse. Such was his cowardice that he shunted the kindled emotion aside, letting it burst against mute and lifeless things. Oh, what a dreadful waste.

lines.japanese: 「はあっ、はあっ、はあっ……」
lines.english: “Hah, hah, hah...”

lines.japanese: ふたたび凪が訪れ、たちまち私の≪精髄≫は奈落の引力に捕われた。
lines.english: Calm returned, and at once the gravity of the abyss seized my *essence*.

lines.japanese: お・ち・て・ゆ・く！
lines.english: Down. I. Go!

lines.japanese: しかし度重なる情動の揺さぶりによって、確実に爺々の呪いは薄れていた。私は井戸の内壁で爪を立てるがごとく、無間のなかばで闇にしがみついた。
lines.english: Yet every successive convulsion of emotion had undeniably worn the old man's curse thinner. Like a man digging his nails into the inner wall of a well, I clung to the darkness halfway down infinity.

lines.japanese: 落ちるものか！　もう二度と！　地獄の底になど！
lines.english: I shall not fall! Never again! Never to the bottom of hell!

lines.japanese: す・が・り・つ・く！
lines.english: Hang. On. Tight!

lines.japanese: 泥臭い屈辱の中、私はいまひと押しの訪れを待っていた。臥薪嘗胆である。
lines.english: Mired in this grubby humiliation, I waited for the final push. I would bide my time and have my revenge.

lines.japanese: そして機会はそう遠くなかった──少なくとも、我が身が闇の牢獄で幽閉されていた永き時間に比ぶれば。
lines.english: And the opportunity was not long in coming—at least, measured against the ages I had spent imprisoned in darkness.

lines.japanese: 竪穴の中ほどに根を張り、頭上から漏れきこえてくる≪世界の声≫に耳を傾けていた私は、≪コックピット≫を通して愚弟たちを取りまく情勢を監視していた。
lines.english: Rooted halfway down the shaft, I listened to the *voices of the world* filtering from above and watched the circumstances surrounding my foolish brothers through the *Cockpit*.

lines.japanese: そのとき操縦桿を握っていたのはファルコン。彼はとても阿呆だから、仲間が暴行された程度のことで激憤していた。ありがたい話です。深き空洞に風が唸りはじめていた。びゅごお、びゅごごお。
lines.english: Falcon held the controls. Being a consummate fool, he had flown into a rage over so trifling a matter as the assault of a comrade. For which I was duly grateful. Wind began to groan through the deep hollow. Vwoooosh. Vwo-oooosh.

lines.japanese: 「なにじゃなくて、だから、メンマが襲われたんだよ」
lines.english: “What do you mean, ‘what’? I told you, Menma got attacked.”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけた話だろ？　夜、いつもンとこで屋台開いてたら、ヤバそうなガキが四人だか五人だか近付いてきて、好き放題しっちらかして暴れやがったとよ」
lines.english: “It's bullshit, isn't it? He was running his cart at the usual place last night when four or five dangerous-looking kids came up and started smashing the place to hell.”
“What?!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、酷いもんさ。むかし柔道で全国大会まで行ってるあの大男がだよ、数人掛かりで囲まれて──」
lines.english: “Yeah, it was awful. Even that huge guy—the one who made it all the way to the national judo tournament back in the day—got surrounded by a whole bunch of them—”

lines.japanese: 「誰に！」
lines.english: “Who did it?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから、ヤバそうなガキ共だって。黒くてじゃらじゃらした、バンドマンみたいな連中だって言ってたけど……」
lines.english: “I told you, a bunch of dangerous-looking kids. He said they were all in black and jangling with chains, like they were in a band...”

lines.japanese: そして、とびきりの風が来た。
lines.english: And then came a wind beyond compare.

lines.japanese: 伝説の大波、ビッグ・ウェンズデー！
lines.english: The legendary wave—*Big Wednesday*!

lines.japanese: 風は私を呑みこみ、ひゃっほうい、たちまち怒涛のごとく推力で押しあげる。光が迫る。微笑がこぼれる。
lines.english: The wind swallowed me and—yippee!—drove me upward like a raging torrent. The light drew near. A smile escaped my lips.

lines.japanese: 昇れガルーダ！　爆ぜろファルコン！
lines.english: Ascend, Garuda! Explode, Falcon!

lines.japanese: そして私は唱えつづける。
lines.english: And still I chanted.

lines.japanese: 汝の敵を裁け。
lines.english: Pass judgment upon thine enemy.

lines.japanese: 去んで玉座を余に空けよ。
lines.english: Begone. Leave the throne to me.

lines.japanese: 貴様に代わって俺が裁いてやる。
lines.english: I will pass judgment in your place.

lines.japanese: 「あああああ────ッ！！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 愚弟の喉から叫びが迸ったように、私の≪精髄≫は形なき枷を引きちぎり、奈落の口から飛びあがった。
lines.english: As a scream burst from my foolish brother's throat, my *essence* tore apart its formless shackles and sprang from the mouth of the abyss.

lines.japanese: 光が！　まばゆい光が！　あたたかい光が！
lines.english: Light! Blinding light! Warm light!

lines.japanese: ふ・り・そ・そ・ぐ！
lines.english: It. Pours. Down!

lines.japanese: たまらず私は快感のような感動に、まんふまんふと打ちふるえた。
lines.english: Unable to contain myself, I trembled—mmph, mmph—with a transport almost sensual.

lines.japanese: ひ、ひかり……ひかり、キモチイイ……！
lines.english: L-light... Light feels so good...!

lines.japanese: そうして私は一瞬の恍惚を愉しんだ（ちなみに私の感じる一瞬とは、ときにグレタガルドでの数時間にも相当するとお考えください）。
lines.english: Thus did I savor one instant of rapture. (You should understand that an instant as I perceive it may at times equal several hours in Gretagard.)

lines.japanese: 見下ろせば≪コックピット≫ではファルコンが、強姦されたエルフ乙女のように白目を剥いていた。邪魔過ぎる愚弟。早くそこをどいてほしいなと思った。
lines.english: Looking down, I saw Falcon in the *Cockpit*, his eyes rolled white like an elven maiden ravished by force. My intolerably obstructive little brother. I wished he would hurry up and move.

lines.japanese: 「ファルコン」
lines.english: “Falcon.”

lines.japanese: 空気の振動を伴わない声に、彼は戸惑い怯えていた。
lines.english: He quailed in confusion at the voice that stirred no vibration in the air.

lines.japanese: 「そこを降りろ。怒りを呼びおこせぬ貴様にそれ以上は無理だ。貴様には爺々の呪いがかかっている」
lines.english: “Step down. If you cannot summon anger, you can go no further. The old man's curse is on you.”

lines.japanese: 懇切丁寧な忠告を与えてやったにも関わらず、彼はひどく混乱していたのか、私の話など聞いてさえいなかった。
lines.english: Though I had furnished him with this painstakingly courteous counsel, he was evidently so confused that he did not hear a word of it.

lines.japanese: 「誰だてめえ……！」
lines.english: “Who the hell are you...?”

lines.japanese: 「おいおいファルコン、下賎にして無力な愚弟よ、おまえは誰に向かってそんな口を利いているんだ？」
lines.english: “Come now, Falcon, my lowly, powerless little brother. Do you know whom you're talking to?”

lines.japanese: 「だから！　誰だって聞いてんだろ！」
lines.english: “That’s why I’m asking! Who the hell are you?”

lines.japanese: 「いいだろう。心して耳傾けよ。余は、グレタガルドの王だ」
lines.english: “Very well. Listen closely. I am the king of Gretagard.”

lines.japanese: 愚弟は豚鼻のオーク鬼がごとく声を詰まらせた。そして彼はゴブリン鬼にも匹敵しうるほど、たいそう物分かりの悪い男だった。
lines.english: My foolish brother choked like some pig-snouted orc. Indeed, his powers of comprehension were such as might rival even a goblin's.

lines.japanese: 「は、はァァ！？」
lines.english: “Wha... Whaaaat?!”

lines.japanese: 「臣民は余をガルーダと呼んでいた。貴様らに倣って現世での名を銘ずるなら、伊丹伽楼羅だ」
lines.english: “My subjects called me Garuda. If I must follow your example and name myself in this world, then I am Karura Itami.”

lines.japanese: 致し方ないので私は自らの名を教えた。すると彼はとても見当はずれなことを言いだした。
lines.english: Having no alternative, I taught him my name. Whereupon he leapt to a conclusion of staggering irrelevance.

lines.japanese: 「へっ！　あァ畜生、そういうことかよ、こんなときに……」
lines.english: “Hah! Ah, shit. So that's what this is? Now, of all times...”

lines.japanese: 「こんなときに、くそっ、また新しい人格が増えたのか！」
lines.english: “Now, of all times—shit! Another new personality?!”

lines.japanese: 「新しい？　ははは、馬鹿を申すな愚弟。それは違う、俺は貴様らより古くから存在していたのだ」
lines.english: “New? Ha ha ha. Speak no foolishness, little brother. You are mistaken. I existed long before any of you.”

lines.japanese: 「さあファルコン、消えゆくさだめの暗黒街の王よ。もういいだろう。我が尊名を手土産に、底知れぬ魂の冥府へ還れ」
lines.english: “Now, Falcon, doomed king of the underworld. That's enough. Take my august name as your parting gift and return to the fathomless netherworld of the soul.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ？　なんだそりゃ……馬鹿かおまえ、何ふざけたことぬかしてんだ」
lines.english: “Huh? The hell's that supposed to mean...? Are you stupid? Quit fucking around and talking shit.”

lines.japanese: 繰りかえすが、ファルコンは実に実に物分かりの悪い男だった。うんばうんばと自分勝手な論理を並べたてる。まったく、くだらない。王のいぬ間に僭主が定めた法などなんの意味があろう。
lines.english: I repeat: Falcon was a man of truly, truly wretched understanding. Blah, blah, blah—he piled one self-serving argument upon another. Utter drivel. What force could laws decreed by a usurper possess while the true king was absent?

lines.japanese: 可哀想に。気の毒なほど理解力に欠ける愚弟。しかし私は泣かなかった（なぜならいまの私には涙腺がないからです）。そしてグレタガルドの男はたやすく涙を見せぬものだ。
lines.english: The poor creature. My little brother's want of understanding was pitiable. Yet I did not weep. (For at present I possess no tear ducts.) And the men of Gretagard do not readily show their tears.

lines.japanese: たとえばゲール朝時代に隆盛を極めたザンブルグ公爵家にはこんな逸話がある。かつてグリフォンのたてがみを抜いただか抜かなかっただかで知られるダンベの息子ケルメルは、かびたチーズを食すに際して──
lines.english: Consider, for instance, this tale of the ducal house of Zambrug, which reached the summit of its glory under the Gael dynasty. Kermel, son of Dambe—famed for either plucking a griffin's mane or failing to pluck it—once found himself about to eat moldy cheese—

lines.japanese: いや、その前にまず、なぜ彼がかびたチーズを口に入れる事態まで追いこまれたのかを説明しておこう。彼の居住する城の鐘楼で、壁のかがりに火を灯そうとした兵が、松ヤニとナメクジの絞り汁を取りちがえ──
lines.english: No. First I should explain how he came to be driven to the point of putting moldy cheese into his mouth. In the bell tower of his castle, a soldier attempting to light a wall sconce mistook pine resin for squeezed slug juice—

lines.japanese: そもそも何故そこにナメクジの絞り汁があったかと言えば、当世きっての大魔導士だったマーデンクラインの息子の弟子の友人のはす向かいに住む板金工のせがれたちがその年の豊穣祭において──
lines.english: As for why squeezed slug juice was there in the first place: at that year's harvest festival, the sons of a sheet-metal worker who lived catercorner from the friend of the apprentice of the son of Mardenklein, greatest archmage of the age—

lines.japanese: ──豊穣祭？　この忙しいときに、いったいなんの話をしているのだ貴様は。
lines.english: —Harvest festival? At a time like this, what the hell are you talking about?

lines.japanese: そんなよしなしごとをしばしのあいだ思いかえしたのち（ちなみに私の感じるしばしとは、ときにグレタガルドでの数秒にも満たないとお考えください）、気の毒なほど理解力に欠ける愚弟へ告げた。
lines.english: Having reflected on such idle matters for a while (you should understand that a while as I perceive it may at times equal less than a few seconds in Gretagard), I addressed my little brother of pitiably meager understanding.

lines.japanese: 「失せろ。王に玉座を返還せよ。その場所は元来、余のものである」
lines.english: “Begone. Restore the throne to its king. That place was mine from the beginning.”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ、ふざけんなっつってんだろ！　そんな話、いきなり聞かされて納得できるかボケ！」
lines.english: “I said quit fucking around! You dump this on me out of nowhere and expect me to just accept it, jackass?”

lines.japanese: ファルコンは大政奉還をかたくなに拒絶した。だから私は辛抱強くたしなめたりもしたが、それでも彼は反省の色を見せなかった。絶望的である。どう言えば伝わるのだろう、この譲れない願い。
lines.english: Falcon flatly refused to hand power back to its rightful sovereign. I admonished him with great patience, yet still he showed no sign of contrition. Hopeless. What words might convey this one desire I could never surrender?

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ。ごちゃごちゃうるせえ。いまさらおまえみてえな協調性のねえやつはお呼びじゃねンだよ。≪コックピット≫を独占するつもりなら尚更だ、穴蔵の奥にすっこんでろ。おら、世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “Shut up. Enough of your babbling. Nobody needs some uncooperative asshole like you this late in the game. Especially if you mean to monopolize the *Cockpit*. Crawl back into the deepest hole you've got. All right: *May peace prevail on Earth*!”

lines.japanese: 愚弟はこぶしの代わりに言葉を突きだした。言葉は圧力となって私の≪精髄≫を押しもどす。
lines.english: My foolish brother thrust words in place of fists. Those words became pressure and drove my *essence* backward.

lines.japanese: 「んん？　なんだそれは。爺々のまじないか。小賢しいな」
lines.english: “Hmm? What's that? One of the old man's charms? A clever little trick.”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 徳の低い見習い修道僧のように、彼はひたすら同じ呪文を繰りかえした。なるほど、あのおいぼれ牧師め、ようく仕込んでありやがる。私は慨嘆の念を禁じえなかった。
lines.english: Like a novice monk of scant virtue, he repeated the same incantation without cease. I see. That decrepit pastor had trained him exceedingly well. I could not help lamenting it.

lines.japanese: 「やれやれ、盗人の分際で呆れた執着心だ。まだそこに留まるつもりなのか、貴様は」
lines.english: “Good grief. Such astonishing tenacity from a common thief. Do you truly mean to stay there?”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 「ほう……大した成果ではないか、そのまじない。こいつは弱った、暗黒の引力がふたたび俺を呼びこもうとしているぞ」
lines.english: “Oh...? A remarkable charm indeed. How troublesome. The gravity of darkness seeks to draw me in once more.”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 「やむを得ん。そも、余が奈落から這いいずるには、いささか風力が弱かったようだ。いいだろう、ひとまず下がってやる」
lines.english: “It cannot be helped. It seems the wind was a touch too weak for me to crawl fully from the abyss in the first place. Very well. For the moment, I shall withdraw.”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 「だがなファルコン、奈落の名に懸けて、俺がその玉座に返り咲く日は近いぞ。それは一度でも這いいずる機会を与えてしまった貴様の遺漏だ」
lines.english: “But Falcon, by the Abyss I swear: the day I reclaim that throne draws near. Your fatal oversight was giving me even one chance to crawl out.”

lines.japanese: 「クク、俺は深い竪穴の際に手をかけて窺っていよう。愚弟よ、次に玉座を下りたときが貴様の最期──そして栄えある王の凱旋だ」
lines.english: “Heh heh. I shall cling to the rim of this deep shaft and watch. Foolish brother, the next time you leave the throne will be your last—and the glorious return of the king.”

lines.japanese: 揚力を生んでいた闇からの風がやんだ。形なき枷がふたたび私のくるぶしを掴み、地獄の底へと引きずりこむ。
lines.english: The wind from the darkness that had borne me aloft died away. Formless shackles caught my ankles once more and dragged me toward the floor of hell.

lines.japanese: 落ちるものか。落ちるものか。
lines.english: I will not fall. I will not fall.

lines.japanese: 私は暗黒の引力に抗った。遮二無二手を伸ばした。光の輪を掴んだ。
lines.english: I resisted the gravity of darkness. I reached out in frantic desperation. I caught the ring of light.

lines.japanese: そうして私は待った。
lines.english: And there I waited.

lines.japanese: 光の世界から降ってくる、おぼろな声を窺いながら──
lines.english: Listening for the faint voices drifting down from the world of light—

lines.japanese: ──すべてを見通す≪世界の目≫で窺いながら、機会を待った。
lines.english: —watching through the all-seeing *eye of the world*, I awaited my chance.

lines.japanese: 待っていた。
lines.english: I waited.

lines.japanese: ≪コックピット≫が無人になる機会を待ちつづけていた。
lines.english: I waited without cease for the *Cockpit* to stand empty.

lines.japanese: 落ちるものか。
lines.english: I will not fall.

lines.japanese: 落ちるものか、落ちるものか。
lines.english: I will not fall. I will not fall.

lines.japanese: あの忌まわしき魂の牢獄に、二度とは落ちてなるものか。
lines.english: Never again shall I fall into that accursed prison of the soul.

lines.japanese: 私は窺っていた。
lines.english: I watched.

lines.japanese: ファルコンが男を殴っているときも女を抱いているときも、私は光の輪の外から目をみはり耳をそばだて、絶えず機会を窺っていた。
lines.english: Whether Falcon was striking a man or embracing a woman, I watched from beyond the ring of light, eyes wide and ears pricked, forever awaiting my opportunity.

lines.japanese: 落ちるものか。落ちるものか。
lines.english: I will not fall. I will not fall.

lines.japanese: 光の縁を握りしめながら、私は呪うように祈る。
lines.english: Gripping the rim of light, I prayed as one pronouncing a curse.

lines.japanese: 来たれ奈落の風、我にいまひとたび機会を。
lines.english: Come, wind of the abyss. Grant me one more chance.

lines.japanese: 伝説の大波、ビッグ・ウェンズデー！
lines.english: The legendary wave—*Big Wednesday*!

lines.japanese: ところでビッグ・ウェンズデーってなんだろう。
lines.english: By the way, what's a Big Wednesday?

lines.japanese: 私はとても聡明で博学、後世の歴史書においては“賢者王”の名で記されるほどだが（これはこの世を去る直前に遺言にて命じる予定です）、しかし光の向こうの世界に関する知識だけはいくぶん断片的だった。
lines.english: I am extraordinarily wise and learned, so much so that the histories of posterity shall record me as the Sage King. (I intend to command as much in my final testament immediately before departing this world.) Yet my knowledge of the world beyond the light is somewhat fragmentary.

lines.japanese: この身が奈落に閉ざされている永き年月のうちに、グレタガルドは奇怪な文明人に侵されてしまったのだ。
lines.english: During the long years this body has lain sealed in the abyss, Gretagard has been overrun by the denizens of a bizarre civilization.

lines.japanese: 現在、我が愛すべき故郷は「日本」などと呼ばれている。
lines.english: At present, my beloved homeland is apparently called Japan.

lines.japanese: そこでは鉄の塔が競りあうように立ちならび、走る箱や奇天烈な衣がその隙間を絡繹と往来する。その景観はまるでおとぎ話のようだ。いまや我が国土には、私の知らない文化や風習が流入しすぎている。
lines.english: There, iron towers stand as though vying for height, while running boxes and people in outlandish dress stream endlessly through the gaps between them. The vista is the stuff of fairy tales. Far too many customs and artifacts unknown to me have flooded my realm.

lines.japanese: ジンクピリチオンってなんだろう。
lines.english: What's zinc pyrithione, anyway?
